title: Moonshot AI Kimi K3.1 Pro is now available on Unity Gateway
body:
Moonshot AI Kimi K3.1 Pro is now available on Unity Gateway for coding, knowledge work, and agentic tool use, with native vision and reasoning. It is available on pay-per-token endpoints in `us-east-1`.

To query the model and see supported regions, see [Use foundation models](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/score-foundation-models).
